snippet.title: Those Nights at Fredbear's: STORY MODE - TEASER
snippet.description:
Set directly after the events of the demo, step into the new and improved Fredbear's Family Diner. Now with an updated building, new characters, new mechanics and a branching story that will take you through Sarah's experience working as a new night shift security guard who is on a mission to find out what happened to her missing daughter.

The old animatronics have been replaced with brand new suits, new characters are introduced and secrets are left to be uncovered.
Break open vents, snoop around in restricted areas, evade advanced animatronics and find out what's really been going on at Fredbear's over the years. Uncover the mystery, or let the darkness consume it.

Follow the game on Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/ThoseNightsAtFredbears/896602
